about: Simple software for running online discussion forums.

prs.title: Quoting a post keeps its spoilers hidden
prs.broken: Quoting part of a post that had a spoiler turned the spoiler into plain text, so the reply showed the hidden part to everyone.
prs.changed: Quotes now write spoilers back as spoilers, keeping the images, emoji and links inside them.
prs.matters: People can quote a post without giving away what its author chose to hide.
